plainText:
(Japanese: 特別へん・ピカチュウゲットだぜ！ Special Chapter - Get Pikachu!) is the fifteenth chapter of the Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon! manga.

==Plot==
After having broken off his friendship with Pikachu in an argument, Shu recalls the time when they first met. Realizing that he doesn't want to lose his closest friend, he then goes out to find him again.
